title: cyperus carinalaevis
intro: Cyperus carinalaevis, commonly known as Yellow Papyrus Sedge, is a species of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Cyperus carinalaevis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and aid in the management of diabetes. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
